scope_statement: The dated snapshot covers all 36 official UNdata datamarts, six catalog glossaries as sidecars, every unique Explorer leaf exposed by 32 interactive units, complete MDG and SDG SERIES codelists, the 33-table 2025 Statistical Yearbook manifest, and all 56 current World Statistics Pocketbook technical-note indicators.

layer_5_details.notes: Counts refer to the dated source-exposed metadata snapshot, not copied observation rows. Every variable has a DataElement operationalization and a conservative source-bounded construct.

enumeration.method: Official 36-item catalog denominator; recursive Explorer leaf enumeration with duplicate-filter reconciliation; seven SDMX DSDs; complete MDG/SDG series codelists; official publication manifests for unavailable legacy datamarts.
enumeration.notes: The Explorer snapshot contains 8719 hierarchy nodes. Observation access was independently probed and failures are retained as outcomes rather than treated as missing metadata.

blockers.notes: Some UNdata observation queries return HTTP 500 or time out even when structure and series metadata remain accessible; each such route is marked partially open.
UNdata is an aggregator. Primary authority, methods, revisions, units, and modeled-estimate status must still be checked with the named upstream provider before substantive inference.

scope_statement: Representative deep-map chain limited to World Development Indicators, its documented API data structure, the SP.POP.TOTL variable, the Population size construct, and attached official access resources.

enumeration.method: Manual representative-chain selection from the official WDI catalog, documentation, and Indicators API metadata.
enumeration.notes: This profile does not enumerate the full World Bank Data catalog or all WDI indicators.

layer_5_details.notes: The representative WDI pass registers an API-level DataStructure and one research-matchable indicator variable; source-native field-level DataElements remain to be enumerated.
